title: Citadel CX — support that holds the line
description: Citadel CX handles the customer conversations automation cannot finish, with trained agents working inside your systems from a controlled environment hosted in Canada.
headline: Support that holds the line.
standfirst: Citadel CX takes on the customer conversations your automation cannot finish. Trained agents, working inside the tools you already run, from an environment built to be inspected.
caseBody: Order status, password resets, opening hours — software answers those well and cheaply. What reaches a person now is the exception, the complaint, the request that does not fit the script. Those conversations decide whether a customer stays, and they need somebody who can think rather than retrieve.
controlsHeading: Most outsourced support asks you to take security on trust.
controlsBody: Agents on personal laptops, files downloaded locally, access that lingers long after someone leaves. We built the delivery model first and the service on top of it.

controls.title: Nothing lands on the endpoint
controls.body: Agents work through a virtual desktop. No downloads, no local storage, no route out of the session. The machine in front of them holds nothing of yours.

controls.title: Hosted in Canada
controls.body: Desktops and working data sit in Canadian cloud infrastructure, so you know where your systems are and can tell your own customers the same.

controls.title: Access that genuinely ends
controls.body: Every agent has a managed identity. Revoking it takes seconds, applies everywhere at once, and leaves a record of who reached what.

closeHeading: Tell us what your support looks like now.
closeBody: Whether you handle it yourself, are weighing a first hire, or already outsource and regret it — we would like to hear about it.
